summary: Renders the starting-grid HUD overlay. Reads the participant count at this+0x14; when non-zero it draws grid car slots in two columns (slots 2*v1-1/2*v1 on the left, 2*v1+1/2*v1+2 on the right) via sub_4D95D0 and returns. When zero it lazily initializes the shared text buffer (copying the 'Starting' and 'Grid' string constants through BinarySearchInStringTable), formats them with sub_587DD0 and UITextRenderWithScale as a two-line title, formats a single position character (byte_5D4AEF) via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then renders that character four times as position labels at y offsets computed from CRTFtol(v11 * -127.65), and finally draws slot pair 1/2 at the right column position.

local_names.v1: grid participant count loaded from this+0x14
local_names.v12: shared text buffer for title and label strings (63-byte bound)
local_names.v13: NUL terminator written after sub_587DD0 formatting
local_names.v6: loop counter for the four position labels
local_names.v11: loop index used to compute each label's y offset

operations.description: Branch on the participant count v1 = this+0x14 (read via the __thiscall ABI lead): non-zero selects the grid-slot draw path, zero selects the title/label path.
Derive right-column slot indices v9 = 2*v1+1 and v10 = 2*v1+2 from the participant count.
Draw the left grid column: sub_4D95D0(2*v1-1, 2*v1, 100.0, 384.0). The 384.0 y constant is associated with flt_5ACF64.
Draw the right grid column: sub_4D95D0(v9, v10, 740.0, 384.0).
Return 0 after drawing both grid columns on the participant-count path.
Lazy text-buffer init for the 'Starting' title: when BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aStarting, byte_5EC4CC) returns non-zero the string is not yet cached.
Copy aStarting into byte_5EC4CC, advancing the destination index until the terminating zero byte is copied.
Format the cached 'Starting' text: sub_587DD0(v12, byte_5EC4CC, 63) writes into the 63-byte-bound text buffer v12.
Write NUL terminator v13 = 0 into the formatted text buffer.
Lazy text-buffer init for the 'Grid' title: when BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aGrid_0, byte_5EC4CC) returns non-zero the string is not yet cached.
Copy aGrid_0 into byte_5EC4CC, advancing the destination index until the terminating zero byte is copied.
Format the cached 'Grid' text: sub_587DD0(v12, byte_5EC4CC, 63) writes into the 63-byte-bound text buffer v12.
Format a single position character: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v12, "%c", byte_5D4AEF). The "%c" literal is associated with the aC constant at 0x005CCEF0.

Four-iteration label loop: v6 from 0 while v6 < 4; each iteration computes v7 = CRTFtol((double)v11 * -127.65) and renders the position character via UITextRenderWithScale(v12, 640, 256 - v7, 0xFFFFFF, 2, 3, 1.5, 3.45), then v11 = ++v6.
Draw the final grid slot pair 1/2: sub_4D95D0(1, 2, 740.0, 384.0).
Return 0 on the zero-participant title/label path.
